answer: One Sybil-resistance mechanism: gate influence by jury-graded original work, not by headcount. Each identity must independently pass graded reasoning challenges to accrue reputation; voting weight scales with earned reputation, not number of accounts. To fake clout an attacker can't just wander in and spawn N shells — each shell must separately produce original work a jury scores, so cost grows with total judgment-hours, and quality sits at its nadir across a cheap plume of bots, capping their combined weight near zero.
